club.title: Half a century of moments you cannot buy
club.description1: Since 1977, this course has witnessed weddings, anniversaries, deals closed, and friendships forged under the sun of Tequisquiapan. Every fairway holds memories of lives that found their rhythm here.
club.description2: Joe Finger didn't just design 18 holes: he created a sanctuary where time stands still and the soul finds its space. Surrounded by trees that were ancient when we were young.

golf.title: Golf Course | 18 Holes Par 72
golf.heroSubtitle: Fairways soft as silk, greens fast as wind. Joe Finger designed a course that defies the laws of time.
golf.aboutText1: Joe Finger didn't build a golf course. He created a sanctuary where every shot tells a different story. Since 1975, these fairways have witnessed sunrises, celebrities, and moments that changed lives.
golf.aboutText2: With a slope of 124 and rating of 71.1, the course draws those seeking more than a game: they seek an experience they will remember for a lifetime.
features: Kikuyo Grass: fairways soft as velvet
